notes: Flags: none (F-21 to F-26 do not apply). Fit: F-36 in the 128 x 119" dining room. Across the room against its bench on the bottom wall (b; the room's left and top sides are open, F-42): 73.4" to the living-room line and 48.5" to the kitchen line (the passing sides), 32.25" from the right end to the right wall and 23.6" to the face of the floating BESTÅ on that wall (tight:23.6, an adult's chair there); open (66 7/8") it slides right on guest nights with its kitchen end staying clear of the walkway, 12.6" to the wall at the other end. The light variant of ikea-20600789 (same Measurements rows), chosen for the house style: ash veneer top, legs and frame with a stain and tinted clear acrylic lacquer; wipe clean with a damp cloth. Page: 'Seats 4-6'; the extension leaf adds a seat at each short end. Not badged on this page (the Best seller badge on the search card belongs to the black/brown default). In stock in IKEA Long Island, NY on 2026-10-22. rooms: dining-room, from the staging brief.
